info.label: Provider NPI
info.notes: National Provider Identifier is a unique identification number issued to health care providers by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

info.label: Billing Provider Number
info.notes: Billing provider NPI or number. For rendering providers this represents the office where the services were rendered.

info.label: Service Location Number
info.notes: Service location number of the billing provider.

info.label: Provider Legal Name
info.notes: Full legal name of the provider.

info.label: Enrollment Status Effective Date
info.notes: Indicates effective date of provider enrollment.

info.label: Provider Type Code
info.notes:
Classification of the provider type.

B=Billing Provider

R=Rendering Provider

C=Safety Net Clinic (SNC)

RC=Rendering Provider at SNC

info.label: MSSA ID
info.notes: Medical Service Study Area Identification is based on the 2010 U.S. Census.  MSSA is outlined by the Office of Statewide Health Planning & Development (OSHPD) and composed of one or more complete census tracts in each area.

info.label: Tract ID
info.notes: Census Tract, a small, relatively permanent statistical subdivision of a county or equivalent entity that is updated by the Census Bureau.
